retrievalProfile.description: A high-grain, soft-focus monochrome portrait capturing a candid moment of affection with extreme shallow depth of field.
triggerTerms: vintage black and white film grain
excludeWhen: high contrast studio lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, grainy black and white photograph featuring a young child looking into the distance while an adult with a beard leans in close, creating a sense of protection and intimacy through soft edges and a diffused light quality.
coreVisualRelationships: The child's face acts as the primary focal point despite the soft focus.
The adult's profile overlaps the child's cheek, creating a physical connection.
The hair of both subjects creates a textured frame around the facial features.
The background is completely blurred into abstract shapes to emphasize the subjects.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up; the child's face occupies the upper left quadrant while the adult's head fills the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's eyes, which are the darkest and most defined points in the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the child's gaze, follows the curve of the face down to the point of contact with the adult.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subjects' heads and hair.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks (eyes, shadows in hair, clothing strap)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright whites (highlights in eyes and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range but compressed by the soft-focus effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain, black and white close-up of a child and a bearded man in a soft-focus, candid embrace. Use a shallow depth of field so the background is an abstract blur of light and dark shapes. Ensure the lighting is natural and diffused, coming from the side to create soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out sans-serif or a classic serif font in white or light gray to maintain the delicate, nostalgic mood of the image.

verificationChecks: Is there visible film grain throughout?
Is the focus soft rather than digitally sharp?
Is the composition an intimate close-up?

mustRedesign: Ensure no modern clothing or accessories are visible
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the overlapping faces
Verify the grain is uniform and not blotchy
Ensure the soft focus doesn't obscure the emotional expression
Confirm the absence of any color fringing
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate [Subject A] and [Subject B] + Black and White Film Grain + Soft Focus + Shallow Depth of Field + 1970s Candid Style
